title: Clinical; in vitro; and in vivo evidence of WAPL as a cohesinopathy-associated gene and phenotypic driver of 10q22.3q23.2 genomic disorder.

verified.what_i_actually_checked: Ran paper_context.py: no open full text in Europe PMC, no supplement, no accessions in text or text-mined. NCBI elink from PubMed 42431198 to GEO, SRA and BioProject returned no links. Europe PMC full-text XML for PMC13504337 returned nothing usable.
verified.what_came_from_paper_text_only: All counts come from the abstract: 27 people with WAPL variants, 8 with PDS5A, 8 with PDS5B; CRISPR-edited iPSC (induced pluripotent stem cell) lines and neurons with RNA-seq; mouse Wapl dosage models.

a1_downloadable.note: No deposited dataset found (no GEO/SRA links, no supplement retrievable); per-patient clinical data in rare-disease case series is typically not public. Checked via NCBI elink and Europe PMC, not files.

a2_label_is_a_column.note: No table seen; a phenotype label would have to be built from case descriptions. Paper-only.

a3_inputs_present.note: No input files found; only the abstract was available.

a4_units_stated.note: Nothing to check; no data files.

a5_enough_rows.note: Abstract reports 43 individuals in total (27+8+8) plus a few edited cell lines: far below 400 rows. No file was opened.

a6_fits_laptop.note: A case series and a small RNA-seq experiment would fit easily if they were available.

a8_label_provenance.note: Clinical phenotypes and variant calls would be direct observations, not model outputs (paper-only).

honest_claim_h3: With 43 patients and a handful of edited cell lines, no predictive model could support a claim; this is a gene-disease discovery paper, not an ML dataset.

plain_idea.one_liner: Use a patient's genetic variant in cohesin-release genes to predict which developmental features they show.
plain_idea.train_on: Per-patient variant and clinical feature records; about 43 patients according to the abstract, none verified.
plain_idea.predict: Presence of features such as developmental delay or birth defects, as recorded by clinicians.
plain_idea.why_worthwhile: Could help clinical geneticists interpret new WAPL variants, but far too few patients exist to learn anything.

ml_idea: None viable: rare-disease case series (n=43 people) with no deposited data found.

effort.compute_note: Not estimated; no data to load.
effort.cheapest_killing_check: Already killed: no public data found and 43 patients total per the abstract.

verdict_reason: Clinical case series of 43 people with no deposited data found (no GEO/SRA links, no open full text); fails A1 and A5.
